verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents a public REST/JSON API (v3) covering domain registration, renewal and transfer, full DNS CRUD, SSL retrieval, hosting and webhooks. A probe confirms its llms.txt is live, and the docs add agent-friendly extras: a `/mock` mirror of every endpoint, a `pk1_sb_` sandbox key, dryRun pre-flight checks, Idempotency-Key retries, and scoped API keys. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use (the community items do not discuss the API).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: A clean REST/JSON API to register, renew, transfer and fully manage domains
Full CRUD over records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA, ALIAS, …) and DNSSEC DS records on Porkbun's nameservers
Every real path is mirrored under `/mock`
a `pk1_sb_` key runs every operation against a simulated environment with fake credit (no real registry actions, DNS changes, or charges)
Porkbun is a domain registrar with a developer-friendly REST API for programmatic domain registration
